customers.evidence: Focus on the user and all else will follow.

employees.evidence: We put great stock in our employees

dei.evidence: people from diverse backgrounds with creative approaches to work, play and life

integrity.evidence: so it does not compromise the integrity of our search results

innovation.evidence: Through innovation and iteration, we aim to take things that work well and improve upon them in unexpected ways

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, first-person plural voice throughout, opening with users under the headline 'Focus on the user'. Commitments mix hedged phrasing ('we aim', 'we hope', 'we believe') with absolute claims ('never sold', 'never manipulate'). Revenue and business scale are described factually. Closes with an accountability invitation: 'you can hold us to that' is on the page's intro.
